upstream.name: open-r1/codeforces-submissions
upstream.license: ODC-By 4.0 per card text; card YAML says cc-by-4.0

method: rows of the parent's main split (data/*.parquet) selected by submission_id and rewritten as parquet; every column and value unchanged. selected_accepted / selected_incorrect not kept (curated, code rewritten)

scope.rule: submission_id appears in a user.status body in raw/codeforces_api_user_status/acq-2026-10-07
scope.user_sample: keep every row of user u iff sha256(u)[:8] (hex) < frac * 16^8

notes: Main-split `source` is the original code (pilot 1: md5 equals og_source for all 1,017 rows the curated subset rewrote). selected_* configs are curated and may be rewritten.
No author field upstream; authors come from codeforces_api_contest_status.
Pilot 1 coverage: 99.9% of accepted in-contest submissions, 3.7% of failed in-contest, ~1% of practice.
